items.title: TMUS Stock Rises After Activist Investor Elliott Urges Parent To Drop Merger Talk
items.summary: Paul Singer-led Elliott Investment Management has built a sizeable stake in Deutsche Telekom and wants the company to drop a potential combination with its U.S. wireless unit, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.

items.title: T-Mobile Stock Rises on Report Elliott Opposes Deutsche Telekom Merger
items.summary: The activist reportedly wants the German telecommunications giant to pursue other ways of boosting shareholder value.

items.title: Elliott targets Deutsche Telekom, opposes $300B T-Mobile merger - Bloomberg News
items.summary: Elliott’s move puts the activist directly at odds with Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Hoettges, who has been pursuing a full combination of the two companies since at least April 2026. Deutsche Telekom holds roughly a 53% stake in T-Mobile US, and Hoettges’s plan would have created the world’s largest wireless operator by market capitalization. Instead, Elliott is pressing management to consider alternative paths to shareholder value, with buybacks cited as the preferred mechanism, according to Bloomb
